beyond: The owner's words do not mention log compaction rules. The record adds an archive criterion: "an entry naming no record that is older than the previous landing" is archived. It also adds that calibration, the judge jobs, verify and explain read through the segments, and it sets the exact segment layout. These change what gets built and are not labelled assumptions.
Moving archived entries out of their own files into segments also sits uneasily with the confirmed SR-006, which says every log entry is its own hash-chained file.
